  • 方法详细资料

    • registerAll

      void registerAll(String fallbackPrefix, List<Command> commands)
      Registers all the commands belonging to a certain plugin. 注册属于某个插件的所有命令。

      Caller can use:- 调用者可以使用：

      • command.getName() to determine the label registered for this command * command.getName() 来确定为此命令注册的标签
      • command.getAliases() to determine the aliases which where registered * command.getAliases() 来确定注册了哪些别名
      参数:
      fallbackPrefix - a prefix which is prepended to each command with 为每个命令添加的前缀，用 ':' 一次或多次前置以使命令唯一 a ':' one or more times to make the command unique
      commands - a list of commands to register 要注册的命令列表

    • register

      boolean register(String label, String fallbackPrefix, Command command)
      Registers a command. Returns true on success; false if name is already taken and fallback had to be used. 注册一个命令。成功时返回 true；若名称已被占用而不得不使用后备名称则返回 false。

      Caller can use:- 调用者可以使用：

      • command.getName() to determine the label registered for this command * command.getName() 来确定为此命令注册的标签
      • command.getAliases() to determine the aliases which where registered * command.getAliases() 来确定注册了哪些别名
      参数:
      label - the label of the command, without the '/'-prefix. 命令的标签，不带 '/' 前缀。
      fallbackPrefix - a prefix which is prepended to the command with a 为命令添加的前缀，用 ':' 一次或多次前置以使命令唯一 ':' one or more times to make the command unique
      command - the command to register 要注册的命令
      返回:
      true if command was registered with the passed in label, false 若命令以传入的标签注册则为 true，否则为 false（表示后备前缀被使用了一次或多次） otherwise, which indicates the fallbackPrefix was used one or more times

    • register

      boolean register(String fallbackPrefix, Command command)
      Registers a command. Returns true on success; false if name is already taken and fallback had to be used. 注册一个命令。成功时返回 true；若名称已被占用而不得不使用后备名称则返回 false。

      Caller can use:- 调用者可以使用：

      • command.getName() to determine the label registered for this command * command.getName() 来确定为此命令注册的标签
      • command.getAliases() to determine the aliases which where registered * command.getAliases() 来确定注册了哪些别名
      参数:
      fallbackPrefix - a prefix which is prepended to the command with a 为命令添加的前缀，用 ':' 一次或多次前置以使命令唯一 ':' one or more times to make the command unique
      command - the command to register, from which label is determined 要注册的命令，其标签由命令名称确定 from the command name
      返回:
      true if command was registered with the passed in label, false 若命令以传入的标签注册则为 true，否则为 false（表示后备前缀被使用了一次或多次） otherwise, which indicates the fallbackPrefix was used one or more times

    • dispatch

      boolean dispatch(CommandSender sender, String cmdLine) throws CommandException
      Looks for the requested command and executes it if found. 查找所请求的命令，若找到则执行它。
      参数:
      sender - The command's sender 命令的发送者
      cmdLine - command + arguments. Example: "/test abc 123" 命令 + 参数。例如："/test abc 123"
      返回:
      returns false if no target is found, true otherwise. 若未找到目标则返回 false，否则返回 true。
      抛出:
      CommandException - Thrown when the executor for the given command 当给定命令的执行器因未处理的异常而失败时抛出 fails with an unhandled exception

      void clearCommands()

    • tabComplete

      List<String> tabComplete(CommandSender sender, String cmdLine) throws IllegalArgumentException
      Looks for the requested command and executes an appropriate tab-completer if found. This method will also tab-complete partial commands. 查找所请求的命令，若找到则执行相应的 Tab 补全器。此方法还会对不完整的命令进行 Tab 补全。
      参数:
      sender - The command's sender. 命令的发送者。
      cmdLine - The entire command string to tab-complete, excluding 要进行 Tab 补全的完整命令字符串，不含开头的斜杠。 initial slash.
      返回:
      a list of possible tab-completions. This list may be immutable. 可能的 Tab 补全项列表。该列表可能是不可变的。若没有发送者有权限匹配的命令则为 null。 Will be null if no matching command of which sender has permission.
      抛出:
      CommandException - Thrown when the tab-completer for the given 当给定命令的 Tab 补全器因未处理的异常而失败时抛出 command fails with an unhandled exception
      IllegalArgumentException - if either sender or cmdLine are null 若 sender 或 cmdLine 为 null
